plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-11 from the official Southern Utah University 2026-2027 General Catalog (current edition, catoid=28) Music (BA) program page and its linked official degree map, 'Music & Music Education Degree Maps (2026-2027)', Music (Campus) tab, last updated/reviewed August 3, 2026. Semester placement is the university's official sample 4-year campus academic plan (SUU Program Maps, 2026-2027), which the source itself labels a guide only; students confirm specifics in Degree Works with a Student Success Advisor. The catalog prints Total Credits, BA Degree: 120 (BA only), which the map matches exactly. Every term's courses sum to the map's printed term total (16/14/16/15/14/14/16/15) and the plan to 120. The map's LANG 1010, 1020, 2010 and 2020 rows (4 credits each, 16 total) satisfy the catalog's BA Degree Requirement of 16 foreign-language credits; the catalog does not name LANG courses inside the Music Curriculum. Cross-check: the catalog's Music Curriculum totals 51 credits (Music Foundation 4, Music Core 41, Major Ensemble 6), and every named curriculum course appears in the map. Repeated courses are printed repeats in the map and allow_repeated_courses is set: MUSC 0990 Recital Attendance (0 credits, required_zero) appears in the first six terms exactly as the catalog requires (the catalog also states majors enroll each semester they are on campus; the map prints six terms and no credit is affected either way), and MUSC 1410, MUSC 2410 and MUSC 3410 Individual Applied Music Instruction (2 credits each) each appear twice, matching the catalog's 'must be repeated once' foundation/core structure (4 credits each). MUSC 4800 Senior Recital is a 0-credit requirement (required_zero). The map's six generic Major Ensemble rows total exactly the catalog's 6 ensemble credits at the map's printed 1 credit each (the catalog prints the ensemble courses at 0-1 credits) and are recorded as choice slots carrying the catalog's four ensemble options. The map's five generic MUSC elective rows (1+1+1+1+2) total exactly the catalog's 6 MUSC elective credits. The map titles MUSC 3530 '20th Century Music: History & Theory'; the catalog title 'Twentieth Century Music: History and Theory' is recorded. The map marks MUSC 2110 and MUSC 2130 with a piano-proficiency footnote (exam required before registration), disclosed here. GE and elective rows printed without course codes are recorded as choice slots with synthetic codes.
